questionText: In Panel I of the figure below, the front view and top view of a structure are shown. Which one of the 3D structures shown in Panel II possesses the views shown in Panel I?
explanation:
Step 1: Analyze the Front View
Looking at Panel I, the Front View shows:
• A left section of height $2$ units.
• A right section of height $1$ unit with a vertical dividing line.

Step 2: Analyze the Top View
The Top View shows:
• A footprint spanning a $2 \times 2$ grid with three visible segments arranged in an inverted L-shape.

Step 3: Match with 3D structures in Panel II
• Structure (iv) has a tall $2$-unit block at the back-left, extending forward and to the right by $1$ unit each.
• Looking from the direction of the Front View arrow, structure (iv) forms the exact profile shown in Panel I.
• Looking from the direction of the Top View arrow, structure (iv) projects the exact 2D footprint shown in Panel I.

Therefore, the correct structure is (iv) (Option D).
